caption:
Three questions to answer before you spend a single dollar on ads.

1. WHAT IS A CUSTOMER WORTH? Not the first invoice — everything they spend with you over time. That number is the ceiling on what you can afford to pay to acquire one. Without it, you are guessing at the only limit that matters, and you will either underspend and stall or overspend and not notice.

2. OUT OF TEN PEOPLE WHO CONTACT YOU, HOW MANY PAY? If it is three or more, your problem is volume and ads will help immediately. If it is one, more leads will only waste more money, faster. Fix the conversation before you buy more of them.

3. WHO ANSWERS THE PHONE WHEN YOU ARE BUSY? Not in theory. By name. Most leads are lost here, in the gap between someone raising their hand and anyone replying.

If you cannot answer those three, ads are not your first problem — they are just the most expensive way to discover it.
